{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check data type of 'revenue'
print("Data type of 'revenue':")
print(loyal_completed['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for non-numeric values in 'revenue'
print("Unique values in 'revenue' (first 10):")
print(loyal_completed['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
